registers.label: Spare
lines: Into the wilderness the Spirit drives us, forty days and the long hunger.
We are pilgrims on the way to the cross.
One does not live by bread alone.
We live by every word from the mouth of God.
Under the shadow of the Almighty we make our refuge.
Come, let us worship the Lord, and serve him only.

registers.label: Immersive
lines: Forty days the wind scours the wilderness, and the stones lie like loaves the tempter dares you to eat.
We are pilgrims on the way to the cross.
You who have known the gnaw of hunger, the whisper that you could have it all — come, bring your testing here.
We are pilgrims on the way to the cross.
For the word is near you, already on your lips: one does not live by bread alone.
We are pilgrims on the way to the cross.
Make your home in the shelter of the Most High, and worship the Lord your God, and serve only him.
We are pilgrims on the way to the cross. Amen.

registers.label: Hybrid
lines: Forty days in the wilderness, and the stones look like bread.
Turn us, O God, and we will return.
We do not live by bread alone.
Turn us, O God, and we will return.
Worship the Lord your God; serve him only.
Turn us, O God, and we will return. Amen.
